title: Design System: Mera (v2 — The Dispatch Ledger)

bg.purpose: Page ground. Warm paper in light, ink in dark.

bg-sunken.purpose: Segmented-control tray, media drop areas, skeleton base.

bg-raised.purpose: Panels, inputs, buttons, command trigger: a sheet laid on the paper.

bg-active.purpose: Pressed ground; progress-bar track. Worst-case surface for contrast tests.

border-strong.purpose: Operable edges, table head underline, the variant branch, every dashed and dotted rule.

fg.purpose: Primary content. 16.0:1 light / 15.2:1 dark on bg.

fg-muted.purpose: Supporting text. 7.3:1 light / 6.8:1 dark on bg-active.

fg-subtle.purpose: Metadata, column labels, placeholders. 4.77:1 light / 5.01:1 dark on bg-active (worst case). Not for use inside a pressed chip (2.9:1 on bg-inverse).

accent.purpose: The one action colour: primary buttons, switch on, chart series A, progress, link underline, brand diamond, current-page bar. 6.4:1 light / 8.7:1 dark against accent-fg.

accent-hover.purpose: Primary hover: darker in light, lighter in dark.

accent-soft.purpose: Selected inbox row; index-card hover. A selection, not a status.

focus.purpose: Focus outline and input border on focus. The rail overrides it to #6fd3c0.

ok.purpose: Settled good state. Never used for an action.

warn.purpose: In flight, expiring, needs a look.

danger.purpose: Needs action now. Solid danger dots render as a diamond.

rail-bg.purpose: Always-dark control rail ground, in both themes.

rail-subtle.purpose: Rail labels and icons on rail-bg only (5.3:1). 4.0:1 on rail-active, so the current item promotes its icon to rail-hi.

rail-active.purpose: Current rail item; nav count pills.

rail-hi.purpose: Current and hovered rail items, workspace name, wordmark.

group-tech.purpose: Group identity, as an 8px square mark only.

group-corp.purpose: Group identity, as an 8px square mark only.

group-launch.purpose: Group identity, as an 8px square mark only.

display.purpose: Page heads (h1), Plex Sans 600 20px. 18px in the top bar, 16px below 560px; the index page alone uses 34px.

topbar-title.purpose: The page title in the sticky top bar; truncates, never wraps.

body.purpose: Default text, 14px/1.5; reading areas cap at 70ch.

small.purpose: Table cells, variant rows, inbox previews, buttons.

micro.purpose: Tags, captions, panel footers, field hints, status labels.

label-panel.purpose: Panel titles in condensed tracked capitals, read as column heads on a form.

label-column.purpose: Table headers in condensed capitals over a border-strong rule.

label-rail.purpose: Rail group names, followed by a hairline to the edge.

brand.purpose: MERA in condensed capitals at 0.14em beside the verdigris diamond.

mono.purpose: Plex Mono at 0.92em: hashes, versions, IDs, handles, scores, the top-bar subtitle, nav counts, kbd, counters, chart and calendar times.

shadows.name: popover
shadows.purpose: Light overlay shadow: command palette, mobile rail drawer, calendar reschedule popover.

shadows.name: popover-dark
shadows.purpose: Dark overlay shadow, same three surfaces.

shadows.name: button-lip
shadows.purpose: Key-like bottom lip on secondary buttons only; removed on press.

shadows.name: ring
shadows.purpose: Borders without layout cost: the pressed segment; the separator between overlapping account marks.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Ring on focused inputs, with a verdigris border. Not elevation.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Global prefers-reduced-motion override on every animation and transition.

breakpoints.name: split-collapse
breakpoints.purpose: Splits single-column; three-up grids two-up; inbox list 290px; command trigger 180px.

breakpoints.name: rail-drawer
breakpoints.purpose: Rail becomes a drawer; crumb and subtitle hide; command trigger icon-only; variants stack with the branch at 18px; heads and rows wrap; tables nowrap and scroll inside their panel; page padding 16px.

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: Top-bar primary action icon-only (label kept for assistive tech); title 16px; post set actions take a full row.

layout.name: variant-branch
layout.value: 1px border-strong rule 28px from the set edge (18px below 900px); 14px ticks to each variant

layout.name: table-wrapper
layout.value: .tablewrap (position: relative; overflow-x: auto), added at runtime around every .table

iconography.name: stroke
iconography.value: 1.5px, round caps and joins, no fill (1.25px at 26px)

iconography.name: sizes
iconography.value: 16px default, 14px sm, 20px lg, 26px xl; platform glyphs 11px inside the 22px account mark

iconography.name: sprite
iconography.value: 56 authored symbols: 49 UI icons prefixed i-, 7 filled platform marks prefixed p-

fonts.name: loading
fonts.value: Mockups @import from Google Fonts with system fallbacks; the product should self-host (e.g. next/font).

narrative.overview: Mera looks like a dispatch office's ledger: warm paper, black ink, and a single verdigris stamp for the action that moves things along. Work sits on raised sheets (bg-raised #fffefa) laid on warm paper (bg #f5f3ed). Panel titles, column heads and rail labels are set in IBM Plex Sans Condensed capitals, like the printed headings on a form; people's text is IBM Plex Sans; anything a machine produced is IBM Plex Mono. Every post set draws a branch to its per-account variants, and approval proof is a perforated receipt on a dashed edge. The shell splits by surface: an always-dark control rail holds navigation and the kill switch, apart from the work on paper.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper and black ink; one verdigris action colour (#0b6b5e light / #4cc4ae dark).
An always-dark control rail, with the kill switch alone at its foot.
Three registers of IBM Plex: Sans for reading, Condensed capitals for field headings, Mono for machine data.
Post sets drawn as a branch to their per-account variants.
Dashed rules for separable things (proof receipts, panel footers); dotted rules for definition lists.
Status is a dot shape plus a label; solid danger becomes a diamond.
Every text pair tested to WCAG AA 4.5:1 in both themes.

rules.name: The One Stamp Rule
rules.body: Verdigris means act here or you are here. It is never a status, a group colour or decoration; status green is ok, and neither borrows the other's job.

rules.name: The Two-Block Theme Rule
rules.body: Light and dark are two complete, hand-tuned token blocks. New tokens are authored in both. Rail tokens are the deliberate exception: dark in both.

rules.name: The 4.5 Floor Rule
rules.body: Every foreground clears 4.5:1 on every surface it can land on. Test against bg-active, and against bg-inverse for anything that can appear in a pressed chip.

rules.name: The Three Registers Rule
rules.body: Sans for what a person reads or writes; condensed capitals only for a heading that names a field, column or section; mono only for machine strings. A string in the wrong register is a bug.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Any number compared down a column uses tabular figures.

rules.name: The Two Surfaces Rule
rules.body: Navigation and stopping live on the dark rail; work lives on paper. Nothing operational sits on the rail and the kill switch never appears on paper.

rules.name: The Kill Switch Reachability Rule
rules.body: Stop all automation is pinned to the rail foot, visible without scrolling on every screen, with nothing below it.

rules.name: The One Row Per Account Rule
rules.body: A post set renders one variant row per target account. Bulk actions count only what they act on: Approve remaining 3, not Approve all 4.

rules.name: The No Sideways Page Rule
rules.body: The page never scrolls horizontally down to 390px. Tables live in a .tablewrap; grid and flex children carry min-width: 0.

rules.name: The Sheet-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separation is a tonal step plus a rule. Shadows only for dismissible overlays and the one key lip on secondary buttons.

rules.name: The Line Means Something Rule
rules.body: Solid is structure, dashed is separable or provisional, dotted is a ruled key/value list. They are not interchangeable.

rules.name: The 16-Grid Icon Rule
rules.body: Every icon is drawn on the 16px grid at 1.5px stroke and added to the sprite. No icon fonts, no img icons, no emoji.

dos: Do keep verdigris for action and location only.
Do set panel titles, column heads and rail labels in condensed tracked capitals, and machine data in Plex Mono.
Do draw the branch for every post set, one ticked row per target account.
Do pair every status colour with a dot shape and a label; use the diamond for solid danger.
Do use dashed rules only for separable things and dotted rules only for definition lists.
Do author new tokens in both theme blocks and test against bg-active and bg-inverse.
Do keep the kill switch alone at the rail foot on every screen.
Do give every drag a keyboard path; the reschedule popover is the pattern.
Do let wide content scroll inside its container, never the page.
Do show external tool arguments verbatim wherever a human approves them.
Do self-host the Plex families in the product build.
donts: Don't use verdigris for success, or ok green for an action.
Don't put anything operational on the rail, or the kill switch anywhere else.
Don't set sentences, buttons or emphasis in condensed capitals.
Don't add a coloured edge for selection or identity; the 3px verdigris bar on the current rail item is the one sanctioned edge.
Don't dim information with opacity; disabled controls and a disabled account's platform mark (0.55) are the only exceptions.
Don't add shadows beyond the key lip, the popover shadow and ring outlines.
Don't add gradients, glass panels or a second accent; the top bar's light blur is the one translucency.
Don't collapse several accounts into one row.
Don't put aria-selected on a button; use aria-current="true".
Don't render a picture of a control with real button elements.
Don't let two screens disagree about a count, or a character count disagree with its text.
